method: Read-only final document diff review plus archived evidence/byte/hash/source/link checks. No Cargo, QEMU, network queries, repo edits, or calls to existing runtime verification functions. Manual semantic scope review is identified explicitly.
authorship: Reviewer previously authored narrow new journal-harness synchronization/diagnostic and third-cycle changes; this is an independent documentation/evidence correspondence review, not an independent review of that harness implementation.

checks.name: manual_scope_review:README and AGENTS distinguish old 1342a6a failure, b75f14b implementation, and final 933e720 validation.
manual_scope_review:Acceptance preserves original whole-phase requirements and adds only a bounded E25 lifecycle substep.
manual_scope_review:Compatibility and roadmap retain physical Ubuntu 24.04 / aarch64 USB, hardware G1/G2, automatic recovery, isolation and future phase boundaries.
manual_scope_review:Physical server runbook distinguishes external administrator USB restoration from read-only journal reconciliation and does not recommend deleting unresolved records.
manual_scope_review:Work log preserves development and first-runtime failures, later repair rationale, source SHA and final success chronology.
manual_scope_review:Research report accurately separates disk evidence in journal from inferred retirement in legacy regressions and explains CI log/artifact limits.
manual_scope_review:No reviewed text claims automatic SIGKILL restoration, arbitrary retained-FD revocation, reboot or power-loss validation, or completed hardware/whole Phase 2.
manual_scope_review:Documentation changes after 933e720 do not reattribute existing runtime or CI evidence to a later documentation commit.

boundaries: All runtime and CI evidence remains attributed to 933e720531fd96b7a23616ed687d59b816e0ce09; later documentation or archive commits do not acquire this runtime provenance.
This review does not rerun runtime verification or validate live external URLs; local Markdown file targets are checked, URL fragments are not independently re-rendered.

Automatic driver restoration after SIGKILL, arbitrary USBFS FD copies/revocation, power-loss/reboot durability, real hardware G1/G2, complete Phase 2, ISO, kernel internal hard blocks and Windows USB remain unverified or unfinished as documented.
QEMU journal directly records disk/API/sysfs; legacy regression retirement relies on immutable successful code paths and observed exits/stopped events rather than per-grant disk dumps.
CI archive is UTF-8 connector log text plus official REST state; workflow does not publish every local scenario raw artifact.
Source review, software tests, QEMU and CI each retain their respective evidence limits; no hardware or broad automatic-recovery conclusion is inferred.
